column4: Lab VMs have no TPM (QEMU arm TPM crashes under HVF), and Fleet BitLocker needs one; needs x64 hardware
An offline host runs the queued wipe at its next check-in and comes back as the same host with MDM on; the feed shows only when the command was sent
A known host comes back in the fleet it was in (No team here), not the fleet of the package's enroll secret; Fleet sets the fleet only for new hosts
With the enroll secret rotated, fleetd comes back after the reset but can't enroll ("unauthenticated, or invalid token"); it enrolls 21 s after the old secret is valid again
With end user authentication off, the reset no-bypass host enrolled as a new host (host 30) with no prompt and no end user, MDM on, 15.5 minutes after the wipe
